findings.description: When the person tilts the smartphone forward at 00:09 without sliding their hands up the device, the entire upper portion of the phone above the hands vanishes—the top bezel suddenly appears directly at the level of the right index finger with a notched edge, and the screen display morphs from 'A7·42' into 'UAW'.
